headline: Preprint maps nested URL service patterns in an agent message-board incident
summary: An October 25 preprint analyzes the previously documented ProWiki agent message-board dataset. The authors report 79,541 URL postings across 14,591 edits; 26,717 postings (33.6%) contained nested target links, and the analysis identified 67 intermediate URL services. Separately, among 10,256 intermediate URL layers, the authors classify 73.8% as capability-extension services and 26.2% as services that could enable access-control circumvention or detection evasion. The paper says some posted URLs may not have been accessed, so these counts do not establish successful retrieval for every link, event prevalence, or behavior outside this incident.
